title: PocketMesh
summary: A pocket-sized Meshtastic messenger powered by Linux.
description:
Take Meshtastic with you on a compact, keyboard-equipped device. This Linux port aims to make mesh communication easy to use on the Cardputer Zero and other compatible Linux hardware.

Planned features:
- Mesh messaging — send and receive text messages over a Meshtastic network.
- Direct messages and channels — chat with individual nodes or groups.
- Node discovery — see the devices and people on your mesh.
- Radio and channel settings — configure your connection and preferences.
- Keyboard-friendly controls — navigate and compose messages on a physical keyboard.
- Pocket-sized operation — use your Cardputer Zero as a dedicated handheld communicator.
- Linux support — bring the experience to compatible Linux devices.
